4. GPU Rasters, Hexbins, Heatmaps & Out-of-Core DuckDB

Source: vignettes/raster-hexbin-duckdb.Rmd
raster-hexbin-duckdb.Rmd

GPU Float32 Rasters (add_raster / addRasterImage)

In leaflet, addRasterImage() projects a terra::SpatRaster on the CPU and encodes a static PNG image in R. Changing the color palette, opacity, or contrast range requires re-running R and sending a new PNG.

In glmap, add_raster() packs the raw Float32 cell values in C++17 (GLMR binary packet) and uploads them directly into a WebGL2 RGBA32F floating-point texture:

  1. 0 ms Live Palette, Hillshade & Opacity Switching: The fragment shader maps raw cell values through a 256-entry 4-channel gl.RGBA Lookup Table (LUT) texture and computes surface-normal hillshading on the fly.
  2. Per-Stop Alpha Transparency (#RRGGBBAA): Color ramps with transparent stops (such as #FDE72500 for 0 mm precipitation) automatically discard transparent pixels in the fragment shader (if (lut_col.a <= 0.004) discard;).
  3. Web Mercator Latitude Unprojection: The fragment shader unprojects Web Mercator yy back to geographic latitude (EPSG:4326) so large-extent rasters align tightly with provincial and national borders.
  4. O(1) Cursor Pixel Readout: Moving the cursor over a raster displays the exact floating-point cell value in the bottom HUD and emits input$map_click$raster_value in Shiny.
library(glmap)

bench <- gl_benchmark_data(n_points = 15000L, raster_dim = c(200L, 200L))

# Show all interactive shader controls (palette dropdown, hillshade checkbox, opacity slider)
glmap(basemap = "dark") |>
  add_raster(
    bench$raster_mat,
    bbox = bench$bbox,
    palette = "terrain",
    hillshade = TRUE,
    opacity = 0.80,
    shader_controls = TRUE,
    group = "Elevation DEM"
  )

# Hide interactive shader controls in the legend card (or pick a subset like c("opacity"))
glmap(basemap = "positron") |>
  add_raster(
    bench$raster_mat,
    bbox = bench$bbox,
    palette = c("#FDE72500", "#5DC863CC", "#21908CFF", "#3B528BFF", "#440154FF"),
    opacity = 0.70,
    shader_controls = c("opacity"),
    group = "Precipitation (mm)"
  )

C++17 64-Bit Spatial Hexagonal Binning (add_hexbin)

Aggregate 1,000,000+ points in ~100 ms in C++17 (cpp_hexbin_aggregate) into hexagonal spatial bins colored by point count or mean weight:

glmap(basemap = "dark") |>
  add_hexbin(
    bench$points_df,
    lon = ~lon,
    lat = ~lat,
    weight = ~intensity,
    hex_radius = 0.03,
    palette = "plasma",
    opacity = 0.85,
    extrude = TRUE
  )

Additive WebGL2 Gaussian Kernel Heatmap (add_heatmap)

Render smooth, hardware-accelerated additive density heatmaps directly on the GPU:

glmap(basemap = "dark") |>
  add_heatmap(
    bench$points_df,
    lon = ~lon,
    lat = ~lat,
    weight = ~intensity,
    radius = 20,
    intensity = 1.2,
    opacity = 0.85
  )

Out-of-Core DuckDB & Parquet Viewport Pushdown (add_duckdb)

When your dataset has 10,000,000 to 100,000,000+ rows stored in a .parquet file or DuckDB database, add_duckdb() pushes bounding-box and SQL WHERE filters directly into DuckDB’s vectorized engine as the user pans and zooms—without loading the full table into R memory:

library(DBI)
library(duckdb)

con <- dbConnect(duckdb())
dbWriteTable(con, "sensors", bench$points_df)

glmap(basemap = "dark") |>
  add_duckdb(
    con = con,
    source = "sensors",
    lon = "lon",
    lat = "lat",
    color = ~intensity,
    palette = "turbo",
    where = "intensity >= 20",
    max_features = 50000L
  )
